# Amazon.in

> > India's leading e-commerce marketplace offering millions of products from mobiles and books to groceries, with integrated payment solutions and premium membership benefits.

Amazon.in is the Indian branch of Amazon's global e-commerce platform, providing online shopping across multiple categories with localized payment options, language support, and services like Amazon Fresh and Amazon Pay. The site serves as a comprehensive marketplace connecting Indian consumers with sellers across electronics, home goods, books, and groceries.

## Shopping & Browse

- [Amazon.in Homepage](https://www.amazon.in): Amazon.in homepage: India's online shopping marketplace for mobiles, books, watches, shoes and more
- [All Categories](https://www.amazon.in/b/32702023031): Amazon.in seller onboarding for Amazon Bazaar with zero referral fees
- [Bestsellers](https://www.amazon.in/gp/bestsellers): Amazon.in bestsellers: Most popular products, trending items and hot releases
- [Hot New Releases](https://www.amazon.in/gp/new-releases): Amazon.in hot new releases: Bestselling new and future product arrivals

## Deals & Offers

- [Deals](https://www.amazon.in/deals): Amazon.in deals page: Product recommendations and special offers
- [Amazon Fresh](https://www.amazon.in/fresh): Amazon Fresh: Online grocery shopping in India with up to 40% off on brands

## Membership & Services

- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.in/prime): Amazon Prime India: Membership plans with Prime Video, Music, Reading benefits
- [Amazon Pay](https://www.amazon.in/gp/sva/dashboard): Amazon Pay dashboard: Bill payments, recharges, travel bookings and gift cards

## Account & Authentication

- [Sign-In](https://www.amazon.in/gp/css/order-history): Amazon.in account sign-in with email, mobile, passkey and Google/Apple ID options
- [Language & Preferences](https://www.amazon.in/customer-preferences/edit): Customer language preferences: English, Hindi, Tamil and regional language settings

## Customer Support

- [Help Center](https://www.amazon.in/gp/help/customer/display.html): Amazon.in customer service: Help center for orders, returns, payments and Prime
